title: Inter vs Grêmio: Copa Semi Preview & Betting Insights
flags: The 2026 Copa Libertadores is heating up as Inter and Grêmio face off for the final spot in the semi‑finals.
The second leg will kick off on Thursday, 3 September, at 8 p.m. Brasília time.
Inter, fresh from a narrow 2‑1 win in the first leg, will look to protect a one‑goal advantage.
Grêmio, who managed a 1‑0 defeat, will need a dramatic turnaround to force extra‑time or a penalty shoot‑out.
Inter have won three of their last five matches in all competitions, with a solid defensive record.
The Argentine striker who scored in the first leg is a prime target for goal‑scorer markets.
Grêmio have struggled to find consistency, but their attacking trio has produced a handful of goals in recent fixtures.
The Brazilian winger known for his pace and finishing is a favourite in the correct‑score markets.
The 2‑1 scoreline is a common expectation for Inter, given their defensive solidity, while a 1‑0 win for Grêmio remains plausible if the Brazilian side can break through.
